title: StochasticGeneralizedMonotone.lean

problem_class.label: other
problem_class.details: Unconstrained monotone root finding: find an approximate zero of a continuous operator F:E→E satisfying ⟨F(x)−F(y),x−y⟩≥0. A zero xstar exists with ‖x0−xstar‖≤R. No objective, potential representation, or strong monotonicity is assumed.

oracle.label: other
oracle.details: Stochastic operator evaluations g(x,ξ), with E[g(x,ξ)]=F(x) and E[‖g(x,ξ)−F(x)‖²]≤σ² for every x. Each call uses a fresh IID seed and returns one vector; no sample reuse or samplewise regularity is provided. L0,L1,x0,R,σ,ε,δ are public; F, g, and the sampling law are hidden.
oracle.evidence: LongTails/Setups/StochasticGeneralizedMonotone.lean: Params, IsStochasticOperator, spec.Public, spec.publicInput, and spec.admissible; LongTails/Setups/StochasticGeneralizedSmoothAndConvex.lean: IID; LongTails/Template.lean: Oracle and execute.

distinctive_assumptions.label: generalized_smoothness
distinctive_assumptions.details: For all x,y,M, if ‖F(x+θ(y−x))‖≤M for every θ∈[0,1], then ‖F(x)−F(y)‖≤(L0+L1 M)‖x−y‖. Public L0,L1≥0; global ordinary Lipschitz continuity and differentiability are not required.
distinctive_assumptions.evidence: LongTails/Setups/StochasticGeneralizedMonotone.lean: spec.valid and the segment-bound clause in spec.admissible.

distinctive_assumptions.label: bounded_variance
distinctive_assumptions.details: Uniform central second-moment bound σ² with σ≥0, unbiased evaluations, and IID sampling. No exponential-moment or almost-sure noise bound is imposed, so finite-variance heavy-tailed noise is permitted.
distinctive_assumptions.evidence: LongTails/Setups/StochasticGeneralizedMonotone.lean: IsStochasticOperator.unbiased, variance_integrable, variance, and spec.admissible; LongTails/Setups/StochasticGeneralizedSmoothAndConvex.lean: IID.

distinctive_assumptions.label: finite_dimensional
distinctive_assumptions.details: E is a finite-dimensional complete real inner-product space with its Borel measurable structure. No dimension bound is supplied.
distinctive_assumptions.evidence: LongTails/Setups/StochasticGeneralizedMonotone.lean: Params.finiteE, completeE, measurableE, borelE, and countableE; LongTails/Setups/GeneralizedLipschitzMonotone.lean: GeneralizedMonotone.Public.

accuracy.label: high_probability
accuracy.details: P(‖F(X)‖>ε)≤δ for public 0<δ<1, under the joint algorithm and oracle randomness. The supplied oracle-call budget is fixed, not an expected cost.
accuracy.evidence: LongTails/Setups/StochasticGeneralizedMonotone.lean: spec.successful and spec.valid; LongTails/Template.lean: Convergence and execute.

accuracy.label: other
accuracy.details: Operator residual norm: return a measurable point X∈E satisfying ‖F(X)‖≤ε on the success event, with ε>0. This is an unsquared operator norm, not an objective gap or an assumed gradient norm; no last-iterate requirement is imposed.

setup_category.label: non_standard
setup_category.reason: Monotone root finding with operator-norm-dependent Lipschitz control, finite-variance stochastic evaluations, and a high-probability residual guarantee is a meaningful variant of the classical globally Lipschitz formulation. No repository proofs or implementations were inspected; the literature outcome does not certify novelty.

descriptionHtml:
Stochastic Generalized Monotone Equations

We seek a zero of a continuous monotone operator F:E→E on a finite-dimensional real Hilbert space E. For L0,L1≥0, its Lipschitz constant along each segment is bounded by L0+L1M whenever M bounds the operator norm values on that segment. A given point x0∈E lies within distance R≥0 of a zero. The oracle returns unbiased estimates of F(x) with variance at most σ2, where σ≥0, using independent, identically distributed samples. Given ε>0 and δ∈(0,1), the goal is a measurable output x¯∈E with ∥F(x¯)∥≤ε with probability at least 1−δ over oracle and independent algorithm randomness.

The operator equation is F(x)=0,x∈E. Write ⟨⋅,⋅⟩ for the inner product and ∥⋅∥ for its induced norm. Let Ω be the measurable sample space. The algorithm receives E, Ω, L0, L1, x0, R, σ, ε, and δ; it accesses F through the oracle.

Our assumptions:

Assumption 1 (Continuity and monotonicity). The operator F is continuous, and for every x,y∈E, ⟨F(x)−F(y),x−y⟩≥0.

Assumption 2 (Generalized Lipschitz condition). For every x,y∈E and M∈R, the following implication holds: ∥F(x+θ(y−x))∥≤Mfor all θ∈[0,1]⟹∥F(x)−F(y)∥≤(L0+L1M)∥x−y∥.

Assumption 3 (Nearby zero). There exists x⋆∈E such that F(x⋆)=0,∥x0−x⋆∥≤R.

Assumption 4 (Stochastic operator oracle). There exist a probability measure ν on Ω and a jointly measurable map g:E×Ω→E. For every x∈E, the map g(x,⋅) is Bochner integrable and ∥g(x,⋅)−F(x)∥2 is integrable under ν, with Eξ∼ν[g(x,ξ)]=F(x),Eξ∼ν[∥g(x,ξ)−F(x)∥2]≤σ2. At call k≥0, a query x∈E receives g(x,ξk). The sample variables (ξk)k≥0 are measurable, mutually independent, and each has law ν. The algorithm’s randomness is independent of the entire sample sequence.

Queries may be made at any point of E. After the allotted oracle calls, the output x¯ must be measurable and satisfy PP(∥F(x¯)∥>ε)≤δ, where P is the joint law of the algorithm’s randomness and the oracle sample sequence.

comparisonHtml:
On a finite-dimensional real Hilbert space, F is continuous and monotone, F(x⋆)=0, ∥x0−x⋆∥≤R, and ∥F(x)−F(y)∥≤(L0+L1supz∈[x,y]∥F(z)∥)∥x−y∥. The jointly measurable oracle satisfies ∫g(x,ω)dp=F(x) and ∫∥g(x,ω)−F(x)∥2dp≤σ2, with integrable values and squared errors, and IID samples of law p under P. Here L0,L1,R,σ≥0, ε>0, 0<δ<1. Target: measurable output X with P{∥F(X)∥>ε}≤δ.

import LongTails.Setups.GeneralizedLipschitzMonotone
import LongTails.Setups.StochasticGeneralizedSmoothAndConvex
import Mathlib.Analysis.Normed.Module.FiniteDimension

open MeasureTheory ProbabilityTheory
open scoped RealInnerProductSpace

namespace LongTails.Setups.StochasticGeneralizedMonotone

open OracleTemplate

structure Params extends LongTails.Setups.GeneralizedLipschitzMonotone.Public where
  [finiteE : FiniteDimensional ℝ E]
  [completeE : CompleteSpace E]
  [measurableE : MeasurableSpace E]
  [borelE : BorelSpace E]
  [countableE : SecondCountableTopology E]
  Ω : Type
  [measurableΩ : MeasurableSpace Ω]
  R : ℝ
  σ : ℝ
  ε : ℝ
  δ : ℝ

attribute [instance] Params.finiteE Params.completeE Params.measurableE Params.borelE
  Params.countableE Params.measurableΩ

structure IsStochasticOperator {E Ω : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E]
    [NormedSpace ℝ E] [MeasurableSpace E] [MeasurableSpace Ω]
    (p : Measure Ω) [IsProbabilityMeasure p] (F : E → E) (g : E → Ω → E)
    (σ : ℝ) : Prop where
  measurable : Measurable (Function.uncurry g)
  integrable : ∀ x, Integrable (g x) p
  unbiased : ∀ x, (∫ ω, g x ω ∂p) = F x
  variance_integrable : ∀ x, Integrable (fun ω => ‖g x ω - F x‖ ^ 2) p
  variance : ∀ x, (∫ ω, ‖g x ω - F x‖ ^ 2 ∂p) ≤ σ ^ 2

abbrev spec : Setup where
  Params := Params
  Public := Params
  Instance p := p.E → p.E
  Query p := p.E
  Reply p := p.E
  Output p := p.E
  publicInput p := p
  valid q := 0 ≤ q.L0 ∧ 0 ≤ q.L1 ∧ 0 ≤ q.R ∧ 0 ≤ q.σ ∧
    0 < q.ε ∧ 0 < q.δ ∧ q.δ < 1
  admissible q F O :=
    ∃ (g : q.E → q.Ω → q.E) (p : ProbabilityMeasure q.Ω)
      (P : ProbabilityMeasure (ℕ → q.Ω)),
    LongTails.Setups.StochasticGeneralizedSmoothAndConvex.IID (fun k (ξ : ℕ → q.Ω) => ξ k)
      (p : Measure _) (P : Measure _) ∧
    O = { Seed := fun _ => q.Ω
          law := P
          answer := fun _ (_, x) seed => g x seed } ∧
    Continuous F ∧
    (∀ x y, 0 ≤ ⟪F x - F y, x - y⟫) ∧
    (∀ x y M, (∀ θ ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, ‖F (x + θ • (y - x))‖ ≤ M) →
      ‖F x - F y‖ ≤ (q.L0 + q.L1 * M) * ‖x - y‖) ∧
    (∃ xstar, F xstar = 0 ∧ ‖q.x0 - xstar‖ ≤ q.R) ∧
    IsStochasticOperator (p : Measure _) F g q.σ
  successful q F output P :=
    Measurable output ∧
      (P : Measure _) {ω | q.ε < ‖F (output ω)‖} ≤ ENNReal.ofReal q.δ

end LongTails.Setups.StochasticGeneralizedMonotone
